title: The Library of Little Things | Giggle & Snooze Bedtime Read-Aloud
description:
On Bea’s front steps, neighbors borrow a smooth stone, a tiny whisk, or a star-shaped button. A puddle becomes a voyage, a kite sails over the rooftops, and the moon gets a little company. At this library, a story is all you owe.

For ages 5–8, this Giggle & Snooze picture book makes a gentle bedtime read-aloud. Each borrower comes back to the same familiar shelf, giving the story a soothing rhythm even as their adventures carry them farther afield.
